summary: If the 2.4 inventory uses automationhub_main_url for a load balancer, remove it from the 2.6 inventory, because the load balancer now sits in front of platform gateway and is set with automationgateway_main_url.
questions: Should I keep automationhub_main_url when upgrading to 2.6?
Where is the load balancer URL set in AAP 2.6?

answer_card.title: Remove automationhub_main_url when upgrading
answer_card.answer_md: If your 2.4 inventory sets `automationhub_main_url` for a load balancer, **remove it** from the 2.6 inventory. In 2.6 the load balancer goes in front of platform gateway and is set with `automationgateway_main_url`.
